title: [3.0-beta1] Missing tabs/info in Treatments in NSClient vs AndroidAPS
body:
Using NSClient to monitor my daughter's AndroidAPS setup.

In the new Treatment view there are differences between the views on NSClient vs AndroidAPS
NSclient has 5 icons/lists, AndroidAPS has 7. 
Missing from NSClient are the "timer" icon (it has no lines of information in AndroidAPS so I'm unsure what this should display) and the temp basal icon with the list of temp basals. 
Also, in the Carbs/bolus icon list, the NSClient is missing the Calc line for eac bolus given through the bolus calculator

I have previously used the calc lookup a lot to verify whether the correct profile has been chosen for bolusing, and to check calculations when I don't feel the insulin vs carb count sounds correct. I would very much appreciate if this could be made available again.
